title: Ciclo e folgas: the cycle and days off shape the day (round 2)

screens.title: 1 · Feed
screens.why: Today's cycle day and what it does to the day, in one tag.

pins.label: One tag
pins.text: Dia 2 do ciclo · dia leve, in the phase's colour and icon; on a working day the phase (Dia 9 do ciclo · Folicular). Without a cycle, only Folga / Dia leve.

pins.label: Agent
pins.text: The suggestion and every turn read the day's kind and phase: on a light day it moves a delivery's task to the next working day.

screens.title: 2 · Menu
screens.why: Where the cycle and the days off are set: a new section, Ritmo.

pins.label: Ritmo
pins.text: Ciclo (today's phase icon, Dia 2 · Menstruação; without one, a line asking for it) and Folgas (couch). Each opens its page.

screens.title: 3 · Ciclo
screens.why: Where the cycle stands, the next 30 days by phase, and every day open to correction.

pins.label: Today
pins.text: In the phase's fill: Dia 2 de 28, Menstruação até 1 de nov., and what it does to the day.

pins.label: Next cycle
pins.text: The one primary button: Menstruação começou hoje. A new cycle starts today; every prediction moves.

pins.label: Tap a day
pins.text: Sunday-first grid in the phases' colours, today ringed. Every day can be tapped to correct the prediction (Toque num dia para corrigir).

pins.label: Settings
pins.text: Last period's start, Próxima menstruação (prevista / corrigida por você, pen), cycle length, period length, and Na menstruação Normal / Leve / Folga.

screens.title: 4 · Corrigir um dia
screens.why: The prediction is the person's to change: one tap, one button.

pins.label: Correct
pins.text: What the prediction makes of the day, and one button: vai começar neste dia (ahead) or começou neste dia (today, before). Cycles after it count from there; Voltar à previsão undoes.

screens.title: 5 · Folgas
screens.why: Weekends are off unless put back to work, one weekend at a time.

pins.label: Weekend
pins.text: Saturday and Sunday each Normal / Leve / Folga, Folga by default.

pins.label: Next 30 days
pins.text: Every weekend, the dates off and the cycle's next period with its kind, in date order, then + Adicionar.

pins.label: One weekend
pins.text: Trabalhar puts that weekend alone back to work; the row then says você vai trabalhar (clock, grey) with Desfazer.

pins.label: Light day
pins.text: How much a light day takes (3h of loose tasks); delivery tasks wait for a working day.

screens.title: 6 · Calendário
screens.why: The queue honours the kind of each day, and the heading says it.

pins.label: Heading
pins.text: The same DayMarkTag after the day's name, in Lista and Calendário: Dia leve · 3h (drop: the period), Folga (couch).

pins.label: Fixed stays
pins.text: A fixed block on a day off stays; no free stretches are drawn around it, and no task is queued there.

pins.label: Day off
pins.text: One quiet row, not 15 hours of room. A tap still writes there; on a weekend, Trabalhar puts that one day back to work.
